svg.title: Saint Ripen Tumanggor, S.Kom. — Software Engineer
svg.desc: Software engineer working from the factory floor to the cloud: full-stack and SaaS products, backend systems and integration, cloud and DevOps, industrial automation (IIoT, PLC, HMI, SCADA), and AI with computer vision. Open to work.
